data.name: Gerta
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'geōrgos' meaning farmer. The name Gerta is a feminine form of this Greek word, and it symbolizes the strong connection between the land and its people. It is also a reminder of the hard work and dedication required to cultivate the earth and produce a bountiful harvest.

in_greek.name: Γκέρτα

It emphasizes the importance of hard work and dedication in the pursuit of personal growth and development. Gerta can serve as a reminder that, just as a farmer invests time and effort to cultivate the earth and yield a bountiful harvest, so too can we invest in our own lives to spiritual benefit.
